headline: Semifinal Slaughter: Three Teams Score 170+ While 226 Alpha Brings a Knife to a Nuke Fight
subhead: Week 16 was the fantasy equivalent of a firing squad — Put an AR to My Head, The Olave Garden, and T swift's Baddies all hit cruise altitude while half the league got their teeth kicked in.
matchOfTheWeek: OnlyFants 159.60 over Bo Nix Celli 154.42 was the only matchup with a pulse — Justin Jefferson dropped a 36.40 piano on Celli's head and Cubby still barely escaped by five. Everywhere else was a beatdown by 29+. If you wanted competitive football this week, you watched this game or you watched nothing.
mainRecap:
Put an AR to My Head dropped a league-high 188.78 on Hot Cocks and turned BigD's playoff hopes into a crime scene — Brian Thomas Jr. (28.2) and Saquon (27.0) didn't just win the matchup, they personally signed the death certificate. 41-point margin. Hot Cocks scored 147.78 and got run off the field; that's the cruelest kind of loss.

The Olave Garden put up 188.50 and Patrickreegs is officially the scariest man left in the bracket — Achane's 31 burgers torched LargestofRocks, who got 36.42 from Jayden Daniels AND 32.5 from Chuba Hubbard and STILL lost by 29. Oh, and Tank Dell rotted on your bench for 21.8. Read that back to yourself.

T swift's Baddies cooked Jets' Juniors 171-136 behind Keenan Allen (29.1) and James Cook (27.6), though Tnicolle left Chig Okonkwo and his 23.6 on the pine — imagine winning by 35 and STILL leaving a TE explosion in the chamber. Wunder, meanwhile, ran 100% lineup efficiency and lost by 34. There is no god.

The Good Ladds dismantled MassiveCocks 161-122, but Mig left THIRTY POINTS on the bench including a 27.12 Bryce Young eruption — yes, that Bryce Young, the one nobody on Earth started. Papi countered with Gus Edwards rotting for 20.1. A real battle of decision-making giants.

Stroud Boys handled 226 Alpha 152-114 in what can only be described as Szara forgetting it was a playoff week — 114.34 is league-low, season-defining, send-help numbers. James Conner's 26.6 was basically a solo concert in an empty arena.

And Jonathan Taylor went for 39.80 for The Good Ladds because of course he did.

powerRankings.team: Put an AR to My Head
